cards.intuition: Analyze and sort one memory-bounded input block into an immutable partial index, then merge all partial indexes sequentially.
cards.formula: block → occurrences → sort → partial postings → merge
cards.topic: Blocked Index Construction: Build Runs, Merge Runs

cards.intuition: Term order groups postings, document order enables gaps, and position order enables phrase payload.
cards.topic: Blocked Index Construction: Build Runs, Merge Runs

cards.intuition: Record deterministic input scope, checksum, counts, key range, analyzer version, and completion so retries can prove what exists.
cards.formula: write temporary → validate → commit manifest entry
cards.topic: Blocked Index Construction: Build Runs, Merge Runs

cards.intuition: Equal-sized occupied levels merge upward, just as two one bits carry into the next binary place. At most one segment remains per level.
cards.formula: level i capacity = B × 2^i; live levels O(log N)

cards.intuition: New generations override old document versions; tombstones hide deleted postings until a merge removes them physically.
cards.formula: query-visible record = newest generation unless tombstoned

cards.intuition: Aggressive compaction writes more now to reduce segment probes and stale bytes later. Delayed compaction favors ingestion but taxes queries.
cards.formula: merge frequency trades write amplification for read amplification

cards.intuition: Re-derive one coherent version from source truth, removing tombstones, fragmentation, drift, and mixed historical state.
cards.formula: authoritative snapshot + analyzer version → replacement index
cards.topic: Rebuild vs Merge: Index Update Strategy Tradeoffs

cards.intuition: Process small changes quickly and combine segments over time instead of rewriting the corpus for every update.
cards.formula: incremental write cost roughly W × changed bytes
cards.topic: Rebuild vs Merge: Index Update Strategy Tradeoffs

cards.concept: When rebuild is mandatory or attractive
cards.intuition: Analyzer or payload-schema changes require reprocessing; large delete ratios and small cheap corpora also favor clean replacement.
cards.formula: rebuild triggers: incompatible analysis, high dead bytes, drift, cheap total size
cards.topic: Rebuild vs Merge: Index Update Strategy Tradeoffs

cards.intuition: Use segments for freshness, merges for fan-out control, and periodic source reconciliation or rebuild to bound accumulated mistakes.
cards.formula: incremental updates + background merge + periodic rebuild/reconcile
cards.topic: Rebuild vs Merge: Index Update Strategy Tradeoffs
